# DJ SET — The Legends Wall

> The world's EDM and Trance legends on one neon wall. A single-page directory of
> 78 artists; each tile opens that artist's top tracks and sets, played in place
> via embedded YouTube, SoundCloud, and Mixcloud. No login, no tracking.

## Site

- [Home](https://djset.club/): The legends wall — browse, search, and filter all artists by genre, then press play.
- [Sitemap](https://djset.club/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL list.

## About

- Genres: Trance, EDM, Big Room, Progressive House, Techno, Hardstyle, Drum & Bass.
- Playback: Embeds only — DJ SET hosts no audio or video files itself.
- Support: A built-in tip jar (Stripe) helps cover hosting; the site is free to use.
